children: AIRWA INC. reported results for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $21.24M, driven by new AI services and advertising initiatives, and net income attributable to controlling interest of $(0.51)M. Diluted EPS was $(9.63) for the quarter versus $3464.1 in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue: $21.24M for the three months ended July 31, 2026, compared with $3.00M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 608%.
Net income: $(0.51)M attributable to controlling interest for the three months ended July 31, 2026, versus $0.883M in the prior-year quarter.
Diluted EPS: $(9.63) for the three months ended July 31, 2026, versus $3,464.10 in the prior-year quarter.
Revenue growth was led by AI services and advertising launches; the company said new advertising business generated about $6.0M.
Acquisition of Rafael AI contributed roughly $15.2M in AI services revenue and expanded offerings into healthcare and traditional Chinese medicine research.
Closed acquisition of Best Life, acquiring a 97% stake for $50M, adding cross-border e-commerce distribution and supporting global expansion plans.

Management noted operational integration activities, including reverse stock splits and consolidation work, have slowed filings. The company expects it has sufficient cash for the next 12 months and may pursue capital markets fundraising if needed.
